design_description: A bold, aggressive design featuring an all-over pattern of jagged brushstroke slashes that create constant movement and intensity across the jersey. The vivid green graphics contrast sharply against the black base, delivering a high-energy, camouflage-inspired aesthetic with a modern edge. Neon green trim on the collar, logos, and sleeve cuffs reinforces the striking color palette, while the patterned cuff detail adds a distinctive finishing touch. The seamless full-body artwork wraps naturally across the torso and sleeves, creating a unified and immersive visual identity. Overall, the jersey feels fast, fearless, and contemporary, combining raw brushstroke textures with a bold esports-inspired aesthetic.
